rule: Each family is scored once, on the data named, with Holm at .05 inside the family. No look before the trigger.

families.trigger: ATP and WTA year-end rankings final (births of 1998 complete their window)

tests.form: tiebreaks + deciding sets won above game-share chance, as defined Nov 1
tests.gate: birth-year-out t >= 2, 12/19, forward top-50 not worse
walk-forward paired t >= 2, top-50 not worse

tests.form: ATP .5 linear + .5 tree blend, forward 2026 year-end

families.trigger: next matured outcome data per board (hockey 2020 class after 2026-27; CS2 series after the lockbox season; ATP as above counts once in its own family)

tests.form: mean of live fit and HistGradientBoosting depth 3, lr .05, 300 iters, leaf 40
tests.gate: class-out t >= 2, top-64 and forward better

tests.form: boosted-tree stack on series inputs as run Nov 13
tests.gate: t by month <= -2 and top-50 gate

tests.form: stage grade = .5 live linear stage model + .5 HistGradientBoosting (depth 3, lr .05, 300 iters, leaf 40, l2 1) on every stage input, stages 1-4
tests.gate: per stage: class-out t >= 2 and 2/3 of classes, top-64 MSE not worse, forward (fit 2008-16, grade 2017-20) MSE and top-64 MSE not worse, top-32 realized mean not lower, and not worse with the preseason share in the linear part
tests.note: Nov 15 2026: family test t 4.34 (p .0006) class-out, but every stage failed a forward or top gate on fit 2008-15 / grade 2016-19; adds nothing where the preseason share is in

families.trigger: Oct 2027 preseason prior build, or earlier only if Barttorvik and BPI caches for past seasons are on disk

tests.form: minutes-weighted cbb_next.py projection replacing the roster prior's player input
tests.gate: lined-game margin MAE, tune t <= -1.5 and held one-sided p < .05

families.trigger: 2026-27 NBA season final (the 2017 and 2018 recruit classes reach nine and eight seasons out)

tests.form: continuation-ratio ladder on the FV tiers (P1 as defined Nov 16 2026: rung 1 = shipped P part, rungs 35-55 lam 1, 60-80 lam 10)
tests.gate: ranked probability score gain, t >= 2.33 over recruits, 8 of 10 classes, squared error of E[FV] not worse; scored on the 2017-18 classes plus the pooled ten
